caption: The drawing depicts multiple human figures arranged in diagonals across the page, all oriented in similar directions as if walking or marching. The figures are rendered in simple, stylized forms with bodies composed of geometric shapes and colored primarily in shades of blue and green. Most of the figures have hats, some of which are blue while others are brown; a few hats appear to be floating above the figures' heads. The figures have light-colored faces and hands, and they wear black shoes. Some hold elongated objects resembling batons or sticks. Two curved green lines wind through the composition, passing between the figures. In the lower left and lower right corners of the image, there are small floral designs drawn in shades of pink, yellow, and green. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color without additional detail. The drawing appears as if made with colored pencil or crayon on a textured surface.
title: Crewel Embroidery
